items: Google title and description for every page, ritual, area, event and journal post, in English and Spanish. They are stored in Rank Math's own fields, so Rank Math shows and keeps them once installed. Texts someone already typed are never replaced.
A "Google search: title & description" box under the editor and on the area screen, with a character counter (title up to 60, description 150 to 160).
Rituals and Events page titles and descriptions in Appearance → ZenVida settings → Google.

No duplicate rituals pages for Google: the "how you feel" chips, "For two", "Rituals for travellers" and "Help me choose" now link to /rituals/#feet, #two, #quiz… instead of /rituals/?need=… addresses. Links already saved in pages are updated automatically.
A canonical address on the rituals, area, events and journal pages (until an SEO plugin such as Rank Math takes over), in English and Spanish.
Ritual pages: one reviews section. The page's own Guest reviews section now shows the reviews about that ritual, instead of a second section appearing below it.

Cleaner, more meaningful HTML for search engines and AI assistants: every page has exactly one h1 (pages without a hero get the page name as a hidden h1); heading levels no longer skip (footer column titles, event and journal cards, the quiz question); reviews are marked up as quotations with author, source and date; sections without a title are plain blocks; inline styles moved to the stylesheet.
The homepage title reads "Relax. Recover. Revive." with its spaces.
Dropdown menus: items placed under another item in Appearance → Menus (main menu) now open from a small arrow, on hover or with the keyboard on desktop, and under their parent in the phone menu.
Phone menu: the Book now button text is centred.

Siesta Club page, new editorial layout: a full-width photo cover, a large opening statement, Gold and Platinum as magazine spreads with prices set in large type, a details table, a full-width photo, "the first forty" perks, the terms in brief, the FAQ and a "Reserve a place" section with the calculator. Works on phones; Spanish on /es/.
The page switches to the new layout by itself on update. If the page was edited by hand, it is kept as it is and the new layout is added as a draft page ("Siesta Club, new layout").
Every section is its own block, editable from the block sidebar; the calculator takes its prices from the Gold and Platinum blocks.

New Siesta Club page (/siesta-club/), added automatically and linked in the footer Offers menu: the founding membership with Gold and Platinum plans (6 or 12 months), member benefits, Founding Member perks, how it works, ways to pay, key dates, FAQ, and a "Reserve your place" calculator that shows what is paid today and sends the choice on WhatsApp. In Spanish on /es/.
Every text, price and list is editable in the page's blocks; prices live in the plans block only. Places left: Appearance → ZenVida settings → Siesta Club.
The old address /membership now leads to the Siesta Club page.
